channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Moraes rejeita pedido da defesa de Bolsonaro para receber visitas de filhos no dia dos pais
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes rejected a request by Jair Bolsonaro's defense team for the former president to receive visits from his children on Father's Day, Sunday, June 9. The ruling upholds existing restrictions on Bolsonaro related to ongoing cases before the Court.

item.title: PT registra no TSE candidatura de Lula à reeleição para a Presidência, com Alckmin como vice
item.description: The PT filed with the TSE the registration request for the Lula-Alckmin ticket seeking re-election in 2026, under number 13, backed by the coalition Brasil Pronto pra Mais, which includes seven parties. The documentation was submitted at 11:20 p.m. on Friday (7) and includes the DRAP and individual candidacy requests, though it remains pending electoral court approval. The ticket repeats the 2022 winning alliance and presents an 84-page government plan emphasizing national sovereignty, parliamentary amendment reforms, ending the 6x1 work scale, and expanding health, education, and public safety policies.

item.title: Renan Santos promete acabar com as bets; o que está de fato em jogo
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party for Presidency, vowed to ban betting houses (bets) after sharing a follower's testimony about losing money, going into debt, and having suicidal thoughts due to gambling addiction. He argues the social costs of addiction, indebtedness, and mental health damage justify a radical measure. However, banning bets would dismantle a legalized and taxed market that, in the first four months of 2026, generated R$12.2 billion in revenue and R$4.5 billion in taxes, while also funding much of Brazil’s sports advertising.

item.title: Em programa de governo, Lula cita defesa da democracia, da soberania, regulação de redes e pede debate sobre emendas
item.description: The Lula-Alckmin 2026 government program emphasizes defending democracy, national sovereignty, regulating social media, and debating parliamentary amendments. It also proposes political reform, democratizing the public budget, criticizing high interest rates, strengthening the defense industry, and promoting diversified international cooperation while opposing liberal-conservative agendas.

item.title: Prévia de plano de Tarcísio tem dez eixos e não menciona privatizações
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas released a preview of his re-election government plan featuring ten strategic objectives, notably omitting any mention of privatizations despite their prominence in his first term. The 'Trilhas da Prosperidade' plan covers security, health, education, and the knowledge economy, and must be filed with electoral justice by August 15. It is coordinated by Natália Resende, Environment Secretary and key figure in the Sabesp privatization process.

item.title: TCU livra Janja de mais um processo envolvendo gastos em viagem internacional
item.description: The Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) dismissed an investigation into alleged irregularities in the international travel expenses of First Lady Janja during her trip to Russia, which occurred five days before President Lula’s official visit. The ruling states that Janja’s activities, even if including tourist visits, fulfill her representative and symbolic role in the Brazilian government, thereby justifying public spending. The investigation had been requested by the Chamber of Deputies’ Committee on Foreign Relations and National Defense.

item.title: No Senado, Flávio Bolsonaro apoiou cortes de impostos, mas deixou rigor fiscal de lado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, promotes fiscal responsibility and tax cuts in his campaign, but his Senate record shows support for measures that weakened fiscal discipline, such as the PEC dos Precatórios and the PEC Kamikaze. While advocating for tax reduction and structural reforms, he also approved increases in social transfers and sector-specific tax benefits, contradicting his current fiscal adjustment stance.

item.title: O que diz o plano de governo de Lula divulgado pelo PT
item.description: The PT's 2026 government plan proposes revising the parliamentary amendments system, viewed as distorted and inefficient, advocating democratic regulation to improve public resource allocation. It also emphasizes defending national sovereignty across multiple dimensions — including technological, energy, environmental, and economic — and calls for regulating social media to combat disinformation and hate speech.

item.title: Plano de Lula prevê maior regulação das redes e conselho para ‘soberania digital’
item.description: The PT unveiled its government plan for Lula's fourth term, proposing increased regulation of social media and the establishment of a National Council for Digital Sovereignty. The document calls for 'democratic regulation' of digital platforms to combat misinformation and strengthen Brazil's technological autonomy.

item.title: Americanos, dívidas e eleição (por André Gustavo Stumpf)
item.description: U.S. pressures against the Brazilian government, led by Trump and his allies, create diplomatic tension without solid justification, including the withdrawal of credentials from Brazil’s ambassador in the U.S. and demands for Latin American alignment with Washington’s foreign policy, distancing the region from China. Meanwhile, the Lula government adopts short-term populist measures — such as debt renegotiation, cooking gas subsidies, and low-interest housing loans — to gain electoral support, despite knowing these policies increase public debt and strain the budget, reflecting a historical PT pattern of raising expenditures without matching revenue increases.

item.title: Promessa jamais cumprida por Lula, Autoridade Climática fica de fora de novo programa
item.description: The National Climate Authority, promised by Lula during his 2022 campaign, was excluded from the government program registered with the TSE on August 7, 2026, despite being a key demand of environmentalists and social movements. The omission draws criticism for violating an electoral pledge and weakening the government’s climate agenda. Although the program was filed on Friday, the absence of the climate authority remains a point of contention between allies and opposition.

item.title: Vice de Flávio votou pelo fim da escala 6x1 que o senador tenta barrar
item.description: Federal Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), running mate of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), voted in favor of the PEC proposing the end of the 6x1 work schedule, opposing the senator’s public stance against the measure. While Bolsonaro seeks to block the proposal, his vice-presidential running mate supported it, revealing an internal split within the party over labor reform.

item.title: PT divulga plano de governo de Lula com defesa de soberania em resposta a Trump, arcabouço fiscal e promessa de rever emendas
item.description: The PT released Lula's 2026 re-election government plan, emphasizing national sovereignty in response to Trump, maintaining the fiscal framework, and revising parliamentary amendments labeled as a distortion totaling R$50 billion in 2026. The plan prioritizes boosting public and private investment in logistics, social infrastructure, innovation, and industry, paired with a macroeconomic policy of fiscal responsibility, declining interest rates, and controlled inflation. The 84-page, 13-chapter document has not yet been formally registered with the TSE and allows for amendments during the campaign.

item.title: Mendonça manda PT entregar documentos do congresso da sigla e do projeto Porta-Vozes de Lula
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ordered the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) to submit documents and financial proof regarding the 8th National Congress of the PT and the 'Porta-Vozes de Lula' project. The order aims to verify the legality of party acts and the use of public or private resources in the electoral context.

item.title: Mendonça vê risco de ‘contratação disfarçada de militância’ em projeto do PT
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE described the use of missions, scoring, and ranking in the PT's 'Porta-Vozes do Lula' project as 'juridically sensitive,' ordering the party to submit the initiative's rules and details on any benefits to militants. The decision partially grants a representation alleging the risk of 'disguised hiring of militants'.

item.title: Sem apostar em nenhum candidato à Presidência, Centrão prioriza disputa ao Congresso
item.description: Major centrist parties (União Brasil, PP, Republicanos, MDB, Podemos, and PSDB) have chosen to remain neutral in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, focusing instead on congressional races. These parties control 43% of congressional seats, nearly half of the Electoral Fund, and about 40% of TV and radio airtime, making their neutrality a strategically significant move. This is unprecedented in recent history: in 2022 only the PSD acted similarly, while now the same PSD is running its own candidate (Ronaldo Caiado) without attracting allies.

item.title: Corrupção é espinho no pé dos candidatos favoritos ao Planalto
item.description: Corruption is the second most concerning issue for Brazilian voters, trailing only public safety. With the Federal Police conducting investigations that touch the campaigns of the two leading presidential candidates — Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro — the race is shaping into a zero-sum confrontation, where any advantage for one comes at the expense of the other.

item.title: Lula promete apoiar Motta em 2027 em acordo com Ciro Nogueira, diz jornal
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has agreed with Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) to support a new term for Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) as president of the Chamber of Deputies in 2027, provided both win their respective electoral races. The agreement, reported by Estadão, reflects political coordination between the federal government and its congressional allies.

item.title: Lula registra candidatura e lança programa de governo focado em soberania
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) formally registered Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Geraldo Alckmin as its presidential ticket for the 2026 election under the slogan 'Brasil pronto pra mais'. The registration was filed at 23:20 with the Electoral Justice, officially launching their campaign. The coalition emphasized national sovereignty as a central pillar of their government program.

item.title: Programa de governo do PT faz ginástica para esconder números de Dilma na presidência
item.description: The PT's government program for Lula's re-election, submitted to the TSE, omits any mention of Dilma Rousseff's presidency in its introduction, according to an exclusive report. The strategy seeks to avoid negative associations with Dilma's administration, attempting to present a political narrative detached from her legacy. The article states the text was crafted to 'pretend Dilma's government never existed'.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes, sobre vice de Flávio: “Não o conheço”
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes stated he does not know federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), who has been named as the running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential race. Mendes is the rapporteur of a Federal Police investigation request regarding an allegation of rape of a vulnerable person against Gaspar. The comment was made in an interview on Friday, April 7.

item.title: Imprensa francesa vê eleição brasileira como pleito decisivo entre soberania e ingerências de Trump
item.description: French media characterizes the October 2026 Brazilian election as a decisive contest marked by political wear, deep polarization, and direct influence from Donald Trump. Outlets such as Le Point, Les Échos, and Le Figaro frame the race as a clash between national sovereignty and foreign interference, with Trump acting as a destabilizing force. Coverage warns of an electoral process potentially contaminated by international narratives and disinformation campaigns.

item.title: Caso Lulinha amplia clima de desconfiança no STF
item.description: New investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as 'Lulinha', are increasing distrust among STF ministers, particularly regarding Minister André Mendonça's handling of high-profile inquiries. The newsletter also covers Minister Edson Fachin's proposal on conflict of interest in the Judiciary, the conviction of STJ Minister Marco Buzzi for sexual harassment, and rising complaints at the STF, alongside trends in judicial recovery and AI-related litigation.

item.title: 'Bolsonarismo dinástico': família amplia presença nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro formalized her Senate candidacy for Brasília, with one brother as her alternate and another running for district deputy. Renato Bolsonaro, the former president's brother, is also running for federal deputy in São Paulo. This reflects the advance of 'dynastic Bolsonarism,' as the family expands its political presence in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Wilson Pedroso na Crusoé: Eleitor cansou do personagem. Agora quer saber o plano
item.description: The behavioral research by Realtime Big Data for O Antagonista reveals that Brazilian voters in 2026 are tired of superficial political figures and now demand concrete plans. Surnames, social media noise, and fan-based rivalries will no longer be enough to win votes. Voters want to know what each candidate intends to do, not just who they are.

item.title: Na mira da PF, irmão e suplente de Ciro declara R$ 21 milhões ao TSE
item.description: Raimundo Nogueira, brother and first substitute of Ciro Nogueira on the PP-PI Senate ticket, declared R$19.2 million in assets to the TSE. He is under investigation by the Federal Police in Operation Compliance Zero for alleged irregularities involving Banco Master, including suspicions of receiving a stipend from banker Daniel Vorcaro via CNLF Empreendimentos Imobiliários. The PF alleges that CNLF purchased a stake in Green Investimentos for R$1 million, a transaction deemed undervalued compared to the estimated R$13 million.

item.title: A eleição presidencial e o comércio exterior
item.description: The text discusses Brazil's reliance on agricultural exports to China, highlighting the growth of soy and derivative sales between 2000 and 2024, reaching US$55.3 billion in 2025. It criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged submission to U.S. foreign policy and ignorance of Brazil's historically independent foreign policy, which aimed to diversify trade partners. The central question is what the two main presidential candidates would do to strengthen the agribusiness sector amid dependence on China.

item.title: Lula faz acordo com Ciro para apoiar Motta à frente da Câmara em 2027 e tenta pacto com Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula is seeking pacts with Davi Alcolumbre and Ciro Nogueira to secure Centrão support in 2027, including backing Hugo Motta’s re-election as Chamber speaker and the neutrality of PP and União Brasil in the October elections, in exchange for no opposition to the government and support for allied candidates. The deal also includes Alcolumbre’s Senate re-election bid, conditioned on cooperation with the Planalto, amid PF investigations into parliamentary amendments and the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: Com custo da dívida mais alto em 10 anos, frente quer fixar teto e orçamento 100% impositivo
item.description: Members of the Parliamentary Front for Entrepreneurship (FPE) are preparing a package of Constitutional Amendments (PECs) to cap public debt and make the budget 100% mandatory, aiming to reduce executive power and strengthen the legislature after the 2026 elections. The group criticizes the lack of effective economic proposals from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro to address fiscal imbalance, noting that the average cost of public debt reached 12.68% per year in June — the highest level in a decade. They plan to launch the 'Empreende Brasil' program after the first round and advocate for an administrative reform in Congress.

item.title: Após encontrar Mendonça, ministro da Justiça se reúne com chefe da PF
item.description: Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva will meet with Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues next week, following a meeting with Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The meeting aims to prepare for a possible encounter between Mendonça and the PF chief, amid tensions over the 'INSS Party' investigation, in which Mendonça is the rapporteur and has demanded access to raw documents and prior notice of changes in the investigative team. Union Attorney General Jorge Messias mediated the meeting to ease the conflict between the PF and the STF minister.

item.title: Cúpula do PL sustenta Gaspar na vice de Flávio e quer superar críticas
item.description: The PL leadership maintains Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro’s vice-presidential running mate despite internal and external criticism over the choice of a man instead of a woman, which caused discomfort among the party’s female wing. The decision also revived two controversies: an allegation of rape of a vulnerable person (denied by Gaspar) and scrutiny over a R$ 6.2 million Pix amendment earmarked for São José da Laje (AL), both known to the campaign beforehand. PL leaders, including Valdemar Costa Neto and Rogério Marinho, rule out any change to the ticket, stating only Gaspar’s voluntary withdrawal could alter it, while the campaign seeks to mitigate damage before electoral propaganda begins on August 16.

item.title: Aprovação pelos EUA não garante vinda de embaixador de Trump ao Brasil
item.description: Senator Daniel Pérez received U.S. Senate approval to become ambassador to Brazil, but the Lula government is unlikely to grant agrément before the October elections, following a directive to delay diplomatic appointments until after the vote. Brazil attributes the delay to the U.S. announcing the nomination before formally requesting agrément, violating diplomatic protocol. The U.S. State Department views Brazil's stance as creating obstacles and acting incorrectly.

item.title: "Não gosta do Brasil": Lula peita Rubio e cobra palavra de Trump
item.description: President Lula criticized U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, accusing him of being 'anti-Latin American' and of sabotaging understandings between himself and Donald Trump. Lula noted that while he did not directly attack Trump, Rubio is working behind the scenes to disrupt diplomatic agreements, particularly by pushing for ambassadors aligned with Bolsonarism. The statement reflects Lula’s effort to isolate Rubio and safeguard Brazilian sovereignty in U.S. relations.

item.title: Aliado de Nunes articula para ter comando da Câmara de SP em 2027
item.description: Councilman João Jorge (MDB), an ally of Mayor Ricardo Nunes, is mobilizing to become president of the São Paulo Municipal Chamber in 2027, with Nunes signaling his support. His candidacy challenges the hegemony of the group led by Milton Leite (União Brasil), currently holding the post through Ricardo Teixeira. The dispute reflects a rift in the allied base, following resistance to a proposed party rotation scheme by União Brasil.

item.title: PT mobiliza aliados, bases e redes para dar peso ao lançamento de Lula
item.description: The PT is mobilizing allies, union bases, and social media for Lula’s re-election campaign launch on August 16 at the Municipal Stadium 1º de Maio in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), a historically significant site from his early political activism. The event will feature ready-to-share materials, paid ads, and strong turnout from social movements and allied parties including PSB, PCdoB, PV, PSOL-Rede, and PDT. Lula will be the sole presidential candidate backed by other parties, securing him the most TV airtime among contenders.

item.title: Advogado de liderança do CV foi chefe de gabinete de vereador no RJ
item.description: Lawyer Diogo Pacheco do Couto, former chief of staff to councilman Artur Rodrigues (Podemos-SG) and ally of Douglas Ruas (PL) — president of Alerj and Rio gubernatorial candidate focused on fighting organized crime — defends Paulo Gabriel Malafaia da Silva, a Comando Vermelho leader known as 'GB do Catarina'. Couto left Rodrigues’ office a week ago to coordinate Carol Nunes’ (PL) congressional campaign, while continuing to publicly support Ruas on social media, despite representing a trafficker with over 90 criminal records and armed escorts.

item.title: A lavagem de roupa suja entre Lula e Alcolumbre na casa de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: In a private meeting mediated by STF ministers Cristiano Zanin and Alexandre de Moraes, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre discussed the rejection of Jorge Messias’s nomination to the Supreme Court in April — one of the most traumatic episodes in the strained relationship between the Planalto and Congress during Lula’s third term. The conversation revealed attempts to overcome the institutional impasse caused by the veto of the Union’s Attorney General for a seat on the high court.

item.title: O nome e sobrenome do arrependimento de Tarcísio na segurança pública em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas admits regretting the appointment of Guilherme Derrite as Secretary of Public Security in São Paulo, acknowledging that security is the main weakness of his administration. The statement was made in conversations with allies, according to an exclusive report.

item.title: Únicos candidatos no primeiro debate para governo de SP, Tarcísio e Haddad reeditam duelo de 2022
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad will be the only candidates in the first debate of the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial election, broadcast by TV Band, due to other parties lacking minimum congressional representation. The governor will emphasize his infrastructure and mobility legacy, while Haddad will focus on public security, education, and concessions, leveraging his national experience to tie the debate to the Lula government. The debate will include blocs with free time for candidates to choose topics, as well as journalist-led questions.

item.title: Dino avança em ofensiva contra emendas Pix e chega à verba enviada por vice de Flávio Bolsonaro; entenda suspeitas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to investigate alleged misappropriation of R$55.4 million in parliamentary amendments via Pix, including R$6.2 million sent by Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), announced as running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race. The move is part of a broader crackdown on potential crimes in the execution of parliamentary funds.

item.title: Em plano de governo, Lula promete Ministério da Segurança e reforço da Lei Antifacção
item.description: Lula's 2026 government plan proposes creating a Ministry of Public Security, strengthening the Anti-Faction Law, and approving the Public Security PEC to centralize federal action against organized crime, focusing on intelligence, firearm control, and financial strangling of criminal groups.

item.title: Programa de Lula traz 31 vezes a palavra soberania e rejeita ‘servilismo’ a ideologias fracassadas
item.description: Lula's 2026 government program emphasizes the word 'sovereignty' 31 times, rejecting 'servility' to failed ideologies and criticizing U.S. tariffs under Trump as a threat to national autonomy. The plan advocates for defense investments, the creation of a Public Security Ministry, and economic policies free from strategic subordination, highlighting enacted measures such as the Public Security PEC and strengthening the Federal Police against criminal organizations. Security is framed as a PT differentiator from the right, with proposals for police body cameras, arms control, and coordination among federal, state, and municipal authorities.

item.title: Patrimônio de Nikolas sobe de R$ 36 mil para R$ 3,8 milhões em 4 anos
item.description: The net worth of federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) rose from R$36,820 in 2022 to R$3.8 million in 2026, according to TSE data, a 10,488% increase. Declared assets include a financed R$2 million property (with a R$1.7 million outstanding debt) and financial investments. Ferreira is running for re-election as a federal deputy from Minas Gerais and earns an average net salary of R$33,000.

item.title: Em plano de governo, Lula promete barrar interferência estrangeira
item.description: Lula promises to block foreign interference in Brazil in his government plan for the 2026 elections, defending national sovereignty as a non-negotiable principle. The document, filed with the TSE, covers defense, technology, energy, mineral resources, environment, economy, and digital security, rejecting automatic alignments with other powers and asserting that Brazil will make decisions autonomously according to its national interests.

item.title: 🚨 ELEIÇÕES 2026: o que apareceu para FLÁVIO BOLSONARO e o futuro do BRASIL deixou um grande ALERTA
item.description: The video warns about a potential electoral scenario in 2026 involving Flávio Bolsonaro, suggesting his political future may signal concerning trends for Brazil, though it does not detail specific policy proposals. The tone is cautionary, linking his trajectory to possible institutional or social risks. No clear mention of public policies or government programs is made.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro critica obrigatoriedade de vacinas no Brasil: ‘respeito à liberdade’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized Brazil's mandatory childhood vaccination policy, arguing the state should not impose health decisions on parents. He stated he signed a declaration in Texas to exempt his daughter from vaccination and advocated adopting the U.S. model in Brazil based on individual freedom.

item.title: Cleitinho promete governo com erros e acertos, mas sem corrupção
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) confirmed his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais after an internal party struggle, stating his government will have mistakes and successes but no corruption. He pledged not to attack opponents during the campaign and adopted the slogan 'less State and more people, less State and more municipalities', leading in polls despite uncertainty about supporting Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: O dilema da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro envolvendo o pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign faces the dilemma of leveraging his father Jair Bolsonaro's image as a political asset without violating judicial restrictions imposed on the former president. The team awaits a TSE ruling on the use of AI-generated content, including a video shown at the PL convention, before deciding whether to resume using the ex-president's image in electoral materials. The use of AI is strategic, as the IA nas Eleições Observatory identified Flávio and the PL as leaders in synthetic political content production between January and July 2024.

item.title: Neutro na disputa presidencial, Republicanos vai apoiar Michelle no DF
item.description: The Republicans party declared national neutrality in the presidential race but announced support for Michelle Bolsonaro (PL-DF) in the Senate race in the Federal District. The endorsement came after a meeting with the party’s district president, Joaquim Mauro Silva, and aligns with the majoritary ticket led by Celina Leão (PP), which includes Bia Kicis (PL) and has Gustavo Rocha (Republicans) as vice-gubernatorial candidate.

item.title: Desconfiança entre ministro e diretor da PF prejudica inquérito
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça blocked direct communication of information regarding the Master case investigation to Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues due to mutual distrust. Mendonça suspects Rodrigues of leaking information to the Lula administration, while there are allegations that he favors Bolsonaro's side. This tension undermines the progress of the investigation.
